aesthetics.notes: Muscle & physique. SAME-pattern days (squat + lunge; hinge + single-leg hinge) to drive the muscle harder (COACH-ANSWER UNI-06). Knee days carry the pulls, hip days the pushes (UNI-11). v1.1: every muscle group a full-body day trains gets 2-4 exercises, never 1 (COACH-R2 R2-SES-05) - knee day: quads 3, back 2, shoulders 2 (rear delt + KB face pull, R2-LIB-04), biceps 2, calves 1 (3 sets); hip day: hips 3, chest 2, shoulders 2, triceps 2, calves 1 (3 sets). Days start short (2 sets per exercise) and lengthen as sets are added. Core opens light (2 x 2, R2-SES-03). Heavy squat Monday, heavy deadlift Friday (R2-SES-01). Session 60 min for general clients, about 90 min for bodybuilders (UNI-09). No medball except as warm-up (ATH-05). Aerobic: 4 a week (Blue, Green, Orange + a second easy Orange) + optional 20-30-min walks after workouts, adjustable by the user (COACH-R2 R2-SES-06). v1.2: calves one exercise x 3 sets per leg day (R3-SES-01); every main day lists recommended supersets and block toggles (R3-SES-02).

fat_loss_bootcamp.notes: Weight loss / general fitness / bootcamp. CROSS-pattern sessions so clients stay less sore and can train more often (COACH-ANSWER UNI-06); hinge + push and squat + pull in every session (UNI-11, ORD-06). v1.1: every muscle group the day trains gets 2 exercises (COACH-R2 R2-SES-05) - the second one is a lighter isolation or bodyweight option of the same group (the coach's own cross day already adds leg extensions to the squat day, OBSERVED OT05), so the cross pattern keeps soreness spread. Two formats: GYM (straight sets, 45-60 min, UNI-09; full-body days run about 60 min at the start) and BOOTCAMP CIRCUIT (two circuits of 4-6 stations, 3 rounds x 35-50 s, 35-45 min, 4/5/6 sessions a week - PRG-03 + R2-SES-05). 3 aerobic sessions a week (ATH-07), adjustable up or down by the user (R2-SES-06). Fat loss is muscle building plus energy balance ('MUSCLE BUILDING' header in FAT BURN, OBSERVED). v1.2: calves one exercise x 3 sets per leg day (R3-SES-01); every main day lists recommended supersets and block toggles (R3-SES-02).
